Indie rock darlings Duchy, five members of Dawes, recently settled in Northern California—and they're ready to put in all those hours in their new 1,600-square-foot post office.
The band's one-off debut is a breeze with its "modern" (read: updated classic-rock) sound, a well-muscled but accessible 12-song mix with good beats and a more-than-passable singer in Taylor Goldsworth. However, Dawes isn't just your typical old-school rock band with a modern cred—Rootsy Rock Band's pop production is part of its charm. Goldsworth is good at writing pop songs, as he showed during his time with the very pop Grand Duchy, but the best things here are his raw vocals on songs that are either soaring and angelic or wild and heartfelt. The rest of the group's hard work is paying off
